attempts.summary: Built a fresh 3-member etcd v3.7.1 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (none had etcd previously), loaded it with application keys under /app/, simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped its data directory, confirmed cluster-wide unhealthiness of that endpoint while node1/node2 retained quorum), removed the dead member via etcdctl, added a new node3 member to the existing cluster, and started etcd fresh on node3 with initial-cluster-state=existing so it joined and fully synced. Verified all 3 members healthy and all application keys present on every node. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving boot-id change and full etcd/cluster/data recovery after each restart.
